A multiple-choice quiz engine that shuffles options deterministically, scores auto-answered or interactive sessions, and assigns letter grades.

title: Bipartite Graph Checker and Matcher: Command-Line Tool
description: Bipartite Graph Checker and Matcher built as a Command-line tool. A bipartite graph splits vertices into two sets with edges only across the split; two-coloring by BFS both tests bipartiteness and finds the split. Maximum matching then pairs across the split optimally via augmenting paths. The checker reports the partition and a maximum matching. The coupon collector problem asks how many random draws are needed to collect all n coupons; the expected count is n times the nth harmonic number, about n log n. Simulation shows the long tail as the last few coupons take forever. The tool reports the distribution of completion times. Draws a seeded synthetic sample and reports count, mean, median, stdev, quartiles, and an ASCII histogram.
resume_bullet: Built a Coupon Collector Simulator statistical analyzer in pure Python computing mean, median, stdev, quartiles, and histograms from seeded synthetic data; prints a formatted report with an ASCII distribution plot.

title: Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange Simulator: Encryption Tool
description: Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange Simulator built as a Encryption tool. Two parties agree on a shared secret over a public channel by each raising a generator g to a private exponent modulo a prime p and exchanging the results. An eavesdropper sees only the public values and would need to solve the discrete logarithm to recover the secret. The simulator runs both sides and a passive observer. Encrypts and decrypts data with a hand-written XOR stream cipher using a SHA-256 counter-mode keystream.
resume_bullet: Built a Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange Simulator encryption tool in Python (stdlib hashlib) implementing an XOR stream cipher with a SHA-256 counter-mode keystream; demo performs a full encrypt/decrypt round trip and verifies the result.

title: Digital Root and Casting-Out-Nines Lab: Command-Line Tool
description: Digital Root and Casting-Out-Nines Lab built as a Command-line tool. The digital root is the repeated digit sum of a number, equal to the number mod 9 (with 9 in place of 0), because 10 is congruent to 1 mod 9. Casting out nines uses this to check arithmetic: the root of a sum or product must match the combination of the roots. The lab verifies long additions and multiplications this way. description: LU Decomposition Linear Solver built as a Command-line tool. title: Toy SVD Rank Compressor: Data Pipeline (Etl)
description: Toy SVD Rank Compressor built as a Data pipeline (ETL). The singular value decomposition writes a matrix as U Sigma V^T, and keeping only the top k singular values gives the best rank-k approximation in Frobenius norm. Truncating small singular values compresses image-like data dramatically. This toy pipeline computes a small SVD by eigendecomposition of the Gram matrix and reconstructs approximations. Extracts synthetic topic records, transforms them (drop invalid, normalize, bucket), and loads the clean set to CSV.
resume_bullet: Built a Toy SVD Rank Compressor ETL pipeline in Python (stdlib csv) with extract, transform, and load stages; handles corrupt rows with drop counts and reports per-stage statistics to the console.
